name: atrium
description: Atrium turns a course syllabus into an editable weekly study plan and a grounded tutor.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @atrium/web" "npm run dev -w @atrium/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @atrium/web && npm run build -w @atrium/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && tsc -p apps/server --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
